contentHtml:
Copenhagen: Novo Nordisk will launch its Wegovy obesity pill - known chemically as semaglutide - in Sweden on December 24, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday.

The pill, first launched in the US in January, has helped Novo regain some ground lost to Eli Lilly in the race for obesity treatments.

"We see that more people become interested in treatment when a tablet is available as a treatment option," the company said in a statement.

The drug will not be reimbursed, meaning that pharmacies decide the sales prices to consumers.

The price of the once-daily weight-loss tablet will be comparable to the price of the Wegovy injection, Novo said.

Source : Reuters
